Name: (CP) Nyan Cat as Serpent and Royal Serpent
Author: xiaoxiaotaozhiyo
Description:
Because I am very afraid of flying snakes, I made this mod, which can change the appearance of  Serpent and Royal Serpent, turning them into rainbow Nyan Cats.
In normal Skull Cavern, a Nyan Cat will not have a rainbow tail. A Nyan Cat with rainbow tail only appear in Mr. Qi's dangerous Skull Cavern.

How to install this mod:
1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download and install [url=http://]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Unzip and place this mod in the Mods folder.

Meanwhile, I am also a Youtuber who make videos about Stardew Valley,
You can click here to visit my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@xiaoxiaotaozhiyo]YouTube Channel
[/url]I also upload my ﻿videos on Bilibili，click here to visit my [url=https://space.bilibili.com/6867955]Bilibili Channel[/url]

If you are interested, you can watch my video!
Hope you can enjoy this Mod and have fun!

Hello大家好，我是小小桃纸哟。
因为我很害怕齐先生的危险矿洞的长长的皇家飞蛇，所以做了这个Mod。
在普通矿洞中，这个Mod会把飞蛇变成彩虹猫，但是没有彩虹拖尾。在接到齐先生的任务之后，会把皇家飞蛇变成有彩虹拖尾的彩虹猫。
如何安装：
1、下载安装SMAPI
2、下载安装CP模式
3、解压并放进Mods文件夹中
